newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire says Kindu still in army hands.
newsitem.headline: Zaire says Kindu still in army hands.

text.p: Zaire said the eastern town of Kindu remained in army hands on Friday, dismissing suggestions that rebels had seized the town.
A Defence Ministry official told Reuters that Kindu, a transport hub and base for army operations in the war zone, was quiet at midday on Friday.

"Kindu was calm up until noon (1100 GMT), the last time we contacted the people there," he said, accusing rebels of announcing the fall of the town to sow panic and confusion and make it easier to capture.
Earlier, a U.N. source told Reuters in Nairobi that Kindu and its airport fell on Thursday.
The rebels, who took up arms in October, control towns and territory in the east and have been pushing west since the army launched a much-heralded counter-offensive on January 20.
